1879073193.name: Benediction
1879073193.desc: Your companion uses their wings to partially obscure you and shield you from harm.

1879073577.name: Power of the Eldar
1879073577.desc: You provide a bonus to your Fellowship's Power.

1879088169.name: Unarmed Attack
1879088169.desc: Auto-attack when attacking with single unarmed attacks.

1879095209.name: Spider's Venom (Melee)
1879095209.desc: This warband skill does direct melee damage to your target, then morale over time and can contribute to warband manoeuvres.

1879096873.name: Scribe Manual: Theorbo
1879096873.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the theorbo. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879109289.name: Writ of Health
1879109289.desc:
Stacking Heal-over-time.

May be applied up to three times, increasing the Writ's tier.

+20% Heal per tier increase.

1879205929.name: Nimble Redhorn-goat
1879205929.desc: As a great ally of the Iron Garrison Miners, one can expect access to their most well-trained and quickest goats.  This goat can move as fast as most horses.

1879241641.name: Coda of the Eorlingas
1879241641.desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a power blast of light-based damage affecting an enemy target and those near the enemy.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879252265.name: Stone Throw
1879252265.desc: Hobbits are skilled at the throwing of stones, and have unerring accuracy.

1879266857.name: Thoughts of Gwindeth
1879266857.desc: Calenglad brings his memories of the Blue Lady with him wherever he goes, and such thoughts serve to restore his morale when otherwise he would despair.

1879270569.name: Exsanguinate
1879270569.desc: A powerful attack that leaves the target bleeding.\nScourging Blow will close this wound to deal significant damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879305769.name: White Chicken
1879305769.desc: Summons a white chicken to brighten your day.

1879319977.name: Dash
1879319977.desc: Your steed pushes itself beyond normal limits, increasing its speed for a short period of time.

1879333289.name: Return to the War-stead
1879333289.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Riders of Rohan, you're able to quickly return to the Rohirrim War-stead. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879368105.name: Shield Focus
1879368105.desc: Gain block chance at the cost of movement speed while this skill is active.

1879369001.name: Picnic Pony
1879369001.desc: Brings out a picnic pony to keep you company.

1879406121.name: Return to Limlók
1879406121.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Protectors of Wilderland, you're able to quickly return to Limlók. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879459113.name: Valiant Strike
1879459113.desc: A strike that instantly heals the Morale of your Fellowship.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879466281.name: Sludge Pot
1879466281.desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879467817.name: Trample (Dual)
1879467817.desc: You trample on your foes with your forceful attack.

1879468841.name: War-steed: Medium
1879468841.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or manoeuvrability.

1879485993.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Umbari Guardswoman)
1879485993.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879490473.name: Ring of Fire
1879490473.desc: An attack leaving a flaming circle upon the ground that enemies fear to enter.\n<rgb=#ff0091>PvMP Variant: Ring of Fire is most damaging when crossing its ring of flames.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description:
After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.

1879490729.name: Shadow Lion
1879490729.desc: Summons a shadowy lion to accompany you on your travels.

1879506601.name: Frost Breath
1879506601.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, expel the chilling gelid wind from your lungs, dealing damage in a cone before you.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879516713.name: Drop Blue Mushroom
1879516713.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879521321.name: Crafty Worm
1879521321.desc: Summons a crafty worm to accompany you on your travels.
